model.name: ACT (LeRobot, inference graph, 34M)
model.note: VAE encoder is train-only (latent z=0 at inference) and is not ported.

hw_notes: Conv activations are HWC padded grids [(H+2)*(W+2), C] with a zero border that is never written; only real pixels are computed.

Every 3x3 conv is the on-chip window kernel (conv3x3_rows): input rows + halo resident in URAM A, the 3x3 window assembled per pixel by SRAM copies, one matvec per (N-strip, K-group) against resident weights. Bias = ones-column block in the weights; residual and K-group partials go through the bias BRAM; ReLU = matvec clamp epilogue.
HW quirk: 0*w leaks a ~1e-38 mantissa and CLAMP maps a denormal pre-activation to +inf, so the clamped matvec must always carry real data or a bias (the ones-column guarantees it).

Stem 7x7/s2 = host space-to-depth(4) of the image (48 -> 64 ch) + 3x3 window conv over the 120x160 super-grid per sub-pixel plane (zero taps dropped); maxpool = 9 plane taps folded on-chip with max(a,b) = b + relu(a-b).

Multi-engine: MultiEngineScheduler master/worker four-phase barrier; convs shard by grid rows (big-weight convs by output channel x rows), tokens by rows, attention by head (per-engine scratch); the two camera backbones run concurrently on NE/2 engines each.
Token seq 602 -> 640 rows with -inf key mask; decoder 100 -> 128. state/latent zero-padded to K=64; action head N padded to 64, host reads [:100, :ACTION_DIM].
Bins: act_bin/params.bin (weights) + act_bin/programs_e<N>/ (per engine count: primary/worker streams + compile-time constants); cache key = weights file + source hash.
